proof_body:
by
  intro f g a b c hac hcb hf hg h1 h2
  have habs : ContinuousOn (fun x => |f x - g x|) (Set.Icc a b) := (hf.sub hg).abs
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => |f x - g x|) MeasureTheory.volume a c :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hac (habs.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_right hcb))
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => |f x - g x|) MeasureTheory.volume c b :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hcb (habs.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc_left hac))
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals i1 i2]
  congr 1
  · refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hac] at hx
    exact abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (h1 x hx))
  · refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hcb] at hx
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (h2 x hx))]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ), a ≤ c → c ≤ b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a c, g x ≤ f x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc c b, f x ≤ g x) → (∫ x in a..b, |f x - g x|) = (∫ x in a..c, (f x - g x)) + ∫ x in c..b, (g x - f x)
